{{Quote|While you're at it, take their so-called pod racer champion, Doane Watki, down a peg or two.|[[Barada/Legends|Barada]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPB" />}}
'''Doane Watki''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] champion of the [[Valarian Syndicate]].<ref name="SWG:JPB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Barada/Legends|Barada]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] chief mechanic, hired a spacer to investigate the [[Valarian Pod Racers Bunker]] because he suspected the Valarian podracer pilots to cheat. He eventually ordered the assassination of Doane Watki.<ref name="SWG:JPB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doane Watki was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Doane Watki was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPB" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
